paragraphs.text: Day 1    Arrival in the Marvellous City

blocks.text: After arriving in Rio de Janeiro, you are transferred to your hotel. The rest of the day is free for your first impressions of the Marvellous City: feel its exciting life, or relax under the palm trees with a coconut water to the sound of samba. Whatever you are looking for, you will find it easily in Rio!

paragraphs.text: Days 2–3    Sugar Loaf and city tour · Corcovado (4 hours each)

Day 2 · After breakfast, a half-day excursion to Sugar Loaf. The first stop is Urca Hill, with a wide viewing area and a restaurant for a snack; from Sugar Loaf, enjoy a beautiful view of Rio, Copacabana Beach, the bay, the surrounding mountains, the islands in the ocean, the Rio–Niterói Bridge and the statue of Christ on Corcovado. After the cable car ride down, the tour continues to the old centre of Rio, with its churches, monasteries, cathedral and colonial-style buildings; your guide then takes you to a local restaurant to taste the local cuisine.
